info.title: LoginLlama
info.description: LoginLlama scores each sign-in to your app for risk. Send the user's identity, IP address and user agent, and it returns a score from 0 to 10 with the reasons: a new device or location, impossible travel, Tor, VPN and proxy addresses, and bursts of failed attempts.

200.description: The risk score and reasons for the login.

status.title: Status
status.description: fail when the risk score is above 5, otherwise pass.

risk_score.title: Risk Score
risk_score.description: From 0 to 10. A common policy: 0 to 2 allow, 3 to 5 watch, 6 to 7 ask for MFA, 8 and above block.

risk_codes.title: Risk Codes
risk_codes.description: Why the login scored as it did. New codes may be added. Current codes: ip_address_suspicious, device_fingerprint_suspicious, location_fingerprint_suspicious, behavioral_fingerprint_suspicious, known_tor_exit_node, known_proxy, known_vpn, known_botnet, known_bot, ip_address_not_used_before, device_fingerprint_not_used_before, ai_detected_suspicious, new_login_location, impossible_travel_detected, geo_mismatch_detected, after_failure_burst, ip_password_spraying, privileged_account.

unrecognized_device.title: Unrecognized Device
unrecognized_device.description: True when this device and browser are new for the user.

authentication_outcome.title: Authentication Outcome
authentication_outcome.description: The outcome sent in the request.

message.title: Message
message.description: A short description of the result.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: production or staging, from the API key used.

test.title: Test
test.description: True for a test key, where the result comes from tags in the identity rather than the login.

email_sent.title: Email Sent
email_sent.description: Whether LoginLlama emailed the user about this sign-in.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Problems with the request that weakened the check, such as an IP address that could not be located.

post.description: Score a sign-in for risk and get the reasons. Call it after checking the password, or before with authentication_outcome set to pending. Report failed attempts too, so LoginLlama can spot password guessing.

identity_key.title: Identity Key
identity_key.description: A stable identifier for the user, such as an email address or user ID.

ip_address.title: IP Address
ip_address.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address the sign-in came from.

user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.description: The user agent string of the client signing in.

email_address.title: Email Address
email_address.description: The user's email address. Taken from the identity key when that looks like an email.

authentication_outcome.title: Authentication Outcome
authentication_outcome.description: The result of your own credential check: success (the default), failed for a wrong password, or pending to check before authenticating.

privileged.title: Privileged
privileged.description: True for an admin or other high-value account. Any risk signal adds privileged_account, and fewer failed attempts count as a burst.

geo_country.title: Country
geo_country.description: The country the sign-in claims to come from, such as US. Worked out from the IP address when left empty.

geo_region.title: Region
geo_region.description: The state or province, as an ISO 3166-2 code or its name. Worked out from the IP address when left empty.

geo_city.title: City
geo_city.description: The city the sign-in claims to come from. Worked out from the IP address when left empty.

user_time_of_day.title: User Time Of Day
user_time_of_day.description: The user's local time, 24-hour HH:mm, such as 14:30.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the sign-in happened, in ISO 8601.
